action.objective: Recapture on d4 with the knight, maintaining material balance and central activity.
action.rationale: f3d4 is the only commit_ready move. Broad depth-3 search over all roots ranked it top (exact 31); single-candidate verification at full depth 4 found no forced mate and no tactical refutation (not_found), with all immediate Black replies checked for mate-in-one. Nxd4 recovers the pawn, and the PV line Nxd4 Bb4+ Bf4 Bxc3+ bxc3 keeps material level with active pieces. Alternatives like c1g5 (30, upper) and d1d2 (26, upper) are shallower upper-bound estimates, not stronger evidence.
